SPKSSB also tests no-kernel barycenter zero; SPKSFS distinguishes loaded-empty/gap/unknown misses from no-file error. Correction routines exercise all nine modes with distinct three-axis motion; string APIs include actual name translation and rotating Earth frame.
routines.errorAssessment: Specific actual NOLOADEDFILES, SPKINSUFFDATA, UNKNOWNFRAME, EMPTYSTRING, INVALIDOPTION and IDCODENOTFOUND where applicable, never two unconstrained failures. JS invalid epoch/type/ID checks are separate from scientific CSPICE errors. NAIF warns about corrupt internal state after raw Fortran I/O failures; no intentionally corrupt/truncated file is supplied to manufacture unsafe behavior.

routines.fixtureRationale: Minimal authored polynomial states independently establish complete values; a separate observer has distinct three-axis motion, giving all corrections nondegenerate components. Initial identical-axis input caused 64 comparisons to exceed absolute1e-12 in cancellation residuals around 0.08km by about4e-12km across compilers. No comparator was relaxed: the more distinguishing fixture retains ordinary scientific components and all 72 correction comparisons pass. Two string routines reuse existing planetary/PCK bytes for noninertial coverage.
routines.cleanup: Every comparison runs actual backend with explicit disposal and isolated Python process. Harness resets/kclears before and after cases, backend disposal frees staged kernels, and priority unload/reload is observed. Actual no-file errors recover after loading kernels. Fault tests restore allocator hooks, free tracked temporaries and exercise actual state/search afterward. Native shared state remains process-scoped; tests use the established single-worker package configuration.
routines.tolerance: Unchanged live1e-12 absolute-or-relative on every component and lt; descriptor integer fields remain exact distinctions. Independent polynomial positions use1e-9km and velocities/light time1e-12 to allow direct-formula/interpolation rounding. Corrected position central difference h=.01s agrees with reported velocity within1e-7km/s; this separate finite-difference bound does not alter live comparison. Physical handle equality is tested within one actual backend against KDATA, not across processes.

findings.summary: Existing single-epoch generated-segment success and broad error registration did not establish full frame/correction/priority/boundary behavior.
findings.repair: New actual raw/SpiceyPy workflows observe every component/light time or all search fields, exact named errors, signed centers, endpoints/gaps, priority changes and reload. Independent literal polynomial/derivative/file-handle assertions reject length-only or unrelated-output success.

findings.summary: Nonfinite query ET was accepted at adapter boundaries; WASM string encoding could coerce non-string inputs. State/position tuples were reconstructed with unchecked casts.
findings.repair: Validate finite ET and actual string types before CSPICE, retain CSPICE scientific validation, validate signed numeric IDs and construct explicit checked tuples. Both actual backend boundary regressions failed before the repair and now pass.

findings.summary: A later string allocation was outside the try/finally scope, leaking earlier allocations on malloc failure. Eight actual failure positions across these four routines failed before repair.
findings.repair: Move later allocations into protected scope with initialized pointer ownership. All 40 actual query/search allocation failure positions release temporaries and permit real post-failure state/search calls.

routines.fixtureRationale: Minimal authored polynomial states independently establish complete values; a separate observer has distinct three-axis motion, giving all corrections nondegenerate components. Initial identical-axis input caused 64 comparisons to exceed absolute1e-12 in cancellation residuals around 0.08km by about4e-12km across compilers. No comparator was relaxed: the more distinguishing fixture retains ordinary scientific components and all 72 correction comparisons pass. Two string routines reuse existing planetary/PCK bytes for noninertial coverage.
routines.cleanup: Every comparison runs actual backend with explicit disposal and isolated Python process. Harness resets/kclears before and after cases, backend disposal frees staged kernels, and priority unload/reload is observed. Actual no-file errors recover after loading kernels. Fault tests restore allocator hooks, free tracked temporaries and exercise actual state/search afterward. Native shared state remains process-scoped; tests use the established single-worker package configuration.
routines.tolerance: Unchanged live1e-12 absolute-or-relative on every component and lt; descriptor integer fields remain exact distinctions. Independent polynomial positions use1e-9km and velocities/light time1e-12 to allow direct-formula/interpolation rounding. Corrected position central difference h=.01s agrees with reported velocity within1e-7km/s; this separate finite-difference bound does not alter live comparison. Physical handle equality is tested within one actual backend against KDATA, not across processes.

findings.summary: Existing single-epoch generated-segment success and broad error registration did not establish full frame/correction/priority/boundary behavior.
findings.repair: New actual raw/SpiceyPy workflows observe every component/light time or all search fields, exact named errors, signed centers, endpoints/gaps, priority changes and reload. Independent literal polynomial/derivative/file-handle assertions reject length-only or unrelated-output success.

findings.summary: Nonfinite query ET was accepted at adapter boundaries; WASM string encoding could coerce non-string inputs. State/position tuples were reconstructed with unchecked casts.
findings.repair: Validate finite ET and actual string types before CSPICE, retain CSPICE scientific validation, validate signed numeric IDs and construct explicit checked tuples. Both actual backend boundary regressions failed before the repair and now pass.

findings.summary: A later string allocation was outside the try/finally scope, leaking earlier allocations on malloc failure. Eight actual failure positions across these four routines failed before repair.
findings.repair: Move later allocations into protected scope with initialized pointer ownership. All 40 actual query/search allocation failure positions release temporaries and permit real post-failure state/search calls.

findings.summary: SpiceyPy found-check decorator raised NotFoundError before its error-check wrapper, masking actual NOLOADEDFILES as a successful miss. A direct locked-version probe proved this; both new live backend comparisons failed before repair.

Physical handle is checked against actual KDATA in independent tests rather than comparing process-dependent handle numbers across processes.
